title: RMA — No Advertising Reference To Agreement
content: ElizaChat and Dentacor restrict mentioning participation in advertising or promotional materials unless the Office approves in writing. Doctronic includes media in that restriction. Legion permits publicity consistent with the agreement’s scope and purpose, and requires prior written approval for promotional statements implying Office or State endorsement.
